title: Password persisted without a hash
exploit: Reach the datastore, dump the table, log in as any team.
breaker: None for the checker, which uses correct credentials. But combined with any read primitive this is a total compromise of the instance.
remediation: Hash with bcrypt/argon2/scrypt and a per-user salt before storing.

title: SQL statement built by string formatting or concatenation
exploit: Boolean, UNION or time based injection in the interpolated value.
breaker: One malformed request from any participant can raise a fatal driver error and the instance stops scoring (IV.5).
remediation: Use parameterised queries exclusively; never interpolate.

title: Unauthenticated GET /dashboard
exploit: Call the endpoint directly without any session or token.
breaker: Usually none: checkers keep using authenticated endpoints, so teams read the data freely while scoring continues.
remediation: Apply the same auth guard used by the neighbouring routes.
